source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.3 with Figs. 3.11 to 3.14 and Example 3.4 (PDF 62-65).

blocks.text: Satellites woh cheezein hain jo Zameen ke gird taqreeban dairawi raste mein ghoomti hain; unhen rockets madar mein dalte hain aur Zameen ki gravitational kheench madar mein rakhti hai. Neeche urte Zameen ke satellites ka acceleration Zameen ke markaz ki taraf 9.8 m s^-2 hai; agar gravitational kheench na ho to woh madar ki tangent ke saath seedhi lakeer mein ur jayein. Daire mein chalte satellite ka acceleration v^2/r hai, aur Zameen ke gird dairawi madar mein centripetal acceleration gravity deti hai: g = v^2 / R ... (3.14), jahan v madari velocity aur R Zameen ka radius (6400 km) hai. Eq. 3.14 se v = sqrt(gR) = sqrt(9.8 m s^-2 x 6.4 x 10^6 m) = 7.9 x 10^3 m s^-1 = 7.9 km s^-1.

blocks.title: Critical velocity aur period
blocks.text: 7.9 km s^-1 satellite ko madar mein dalne ki kam se kam velocity hai, jo critical velocity kehlati hai. Period T, T = 2 pi R / v = 2 x 3.14 x 6400 km / 7.9 km s^-1 = 5060 s = taqreeban 84 min hai.

Agar albatta dairawi madar mein satellite Zameen ki satah se R se bohat zyada faasle h par ho to hamein is tajurbati haqeeqat ka khayal rakhna hoga ke gravitational acceleration Zameen ke markaz se faasle ke muraba ke ulat ghatta hai (Fig. 3.11). Satellite jitna ooncha, darkar speed utni kam aur Zameen ke gird ek chakkar mein utna zyada waqt. Satellite-orbits box 11 km s^-1 (40 000 km h^-1) ki escape speed, 27 000 km h^-1 par dairawi madar aur 30 000 km h^-1 par elliptical madar dikhata hai. Newton ne taqreeban 300 saal pehle apni Principia Mathematica mein masnooi satellites ki peshgoi ki: agar koi cheez kafi oonchi jagah se kafi tez speed se ufqi phenki jaye to woh Zameen ke gird ghoomne lagegi (Do you know).

blocks.alt: Baen taraf radius R wali Zameen aur daen taraf bohat door satellite apne madar (orbit) ki qaus par, velocity v ke saath. Zameen ki sateh se satellite tak dohra teer unchai h dikhata hai, aur note kehta hai madar ka radius r = R + h.
blocks.caption: Zameen ke radius R se kahin zyada unchai h par satellite (Figure 3.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Fig. 3.12 mass m_s ka satellite dikhati hai jo mass M ki Zameen ke gird radius r ke dairawi raste par madari speed v se ghoomta hai. Satellite ko madar mein rakhne ko centripetal force m_s v^2 / r chahiye, jo Zameen aur satellite ke darmiyan gravitational kashish deti hai. Gravitational force ko darkar centripetal force ke barabar rakh kar G m_s M / r^2 = m_s v^2 / r, ya v = sqrt(GM/r) ... (3.15). Yeh dikhata hai ke satellite ka mass us ke madar ke bayan mein ghair-aham hai: Zameen ke markaz se faasle r par ghoomte kisi bhi satellite ki madari speed Eq. 3.15 wali honi chahiye, aur is se kam koi bhi speed satellite ko lurhakte hue Zameen par wapas le aati hai.

blocks.alt: Zameen ke gird dashed daira-numa madar. Madar par satellite ka hara force teer F = GMm / r^2 Zameen ke markaz ki taraf, aur surkh velocity teer v madar ke saath. Dabbe mein m v^2 / r = GMm / r^2, yaani v = square root of GM / r.
blocks.caption: Zameen ke gird ghoomta satellite: centripetal force F aur velocity v (Figure 3.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Example 3.4
blocks.text: Zameen ka satellite Zameen ki satah se 384 000 km faasle par dairawi madar mein hai. Us ka ek chakkar ka period dinon mein kya hai? M = 6.0 x 10^24 kg aur R = 6400 km lein. Hal: r = R + h = (6400 + 384 000) km = 390 400 km. v = sqrt(GM/r) = sqrt(6.67 x 10^-11 N m^2 kg^-2 x 6 x 10^24 kg / 390 400 km) = 1.025 km s^-1 istemal karte hue. Neez T = 2 pi r / v = 2 x 3.14 x 390 400 km x (1/1.025 km s^-1) x (1 day / (60 x 60 x 24 s)) = 27.7 days.

Jab satellite rocket se Zameen ke gird apne matloob madar mein chhora jata hai to us ke andar har cheez be-wazni mehsoos karti hai, kyunke satellite azadana girte jism ki tarah Zameen ke markaz ki taraf tez ho raha hai. Zameen ke gird radius r ke madar mein ghoomta mass M ka satellite lein, aur us ke andar chhat se spring balance se latka mass m ka jism (Fig. 3.13). Jism par do forces lagti hain: us ka wazan mg neeche, aur sahara dene wali force, normal force F_N ya spring ki tension, oopar. Un ka resultant mass m ko darkar centripetal force ke barabar hai, jo Zameen ke markaz ki taraf lagti hai: Fc = mg - F_N ... (3.16), jahan Fc = m v^2 / r, is liye m v^2 / r = mg - F_N ... (3.16-a). Satellite ke Zameen ke gird ghoomne ki zimmedar centripetal force Zameen aur satellite ki gravitational kashish deti hai: F_g = Fc, Mg = M v^2 / r, to g = v^2 / r. Is liye Eq. 3.16-a ban jati hai mg = mg - F_N, ya F_N = 0. Satellite ke andar jism par lagne wali sahare ki force sifr hai, to satellite mein ajsam aur astronauts khud ko zahiri be-wazni ki halat mein pate hain. Aap ka wazan sirf tab thora badalta hai jab lift ki velocity badle, safar ke shuru aur aakhir mein, velocity mustaqil hone par nahi (Do You Know); jab pani se bhari balti amoodi daire mein tezi se ghumai jaye to choti par ulti hone par bhi pani nahi girta (Can you tell). 1984 mein Hawaii se 100 km oopar 29 000 km h^-1 ki speed par Bruce McCandless space shuttle se khala mein nikla aur Zameen ka pehla insani satellite bana (Tid-bits).

blocks.alt: Zameen ke oopar dashed madar par satellite ka dabba, us mein spring balance aur chhota mass. Gravity F = GMm / r^2 Zameen ki taraf, velocity v madar ke saath, aur balance 0 dikhata hai. Note samjhata hai ke dabba aur mass aik hi acceleration se girte hain, is liye spring nahi khinchta aur zahiri wazan sifr hai.
blocks.caption: Ghoomte satellite ke andar spring balance par mass sifr dikhata hai (Figure 3.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Gravity se azaad khala mein koi force kisi ko spacecraft ki kisi taraf nahi dhakelti. Agar spacecraft ko lambe arse tak madar mein rehna ho to be-wazni astronauts ki karkardagi par asar dal sakti hai; is par qaboo pane ko artificial gravity banai ja sakti hai taake amla taqreeban aam tareeqe se kaam kar sake. Spaceship ko apne axis ke gird gardish mein dala jata hai; astronaut phir bahri rim ki taraf dabta hai aur spaceship ke farsh par taqreeban Zameen jaisi force lagata hai. Fig. 3.14 jaisi shakal ka spacecraft lein: us ka bahri radius R hai aur woh apne markazi axis ke gird angular speed omega se ghoomta hai, to us ka centripetal acceleration a_c = R omega^2 hai. Magar omega = 2 pi / T, jahan T spaceship ki gardish ka period hai, is liye a_c = R (2 pi)^2 / T^2 = R 4 pi^2 / T^2. Chunke frequency f = 1/T, a_c = R 4 pi^2 f^2, ya f^2 = a_c / (4 pi^2 R), ya f = (1/(2 pi)) sqrt(a_c / R). Jaisa oopar bayan hua, gravity ki force darkar centripetal acceleration deti hai, to a_c = g aur f = (1/(2 pi)) sqrt(g / R) ... (3.17). Jab spaceship is frequency se ghoome to us ke makeenon ko Zameen jaisi artificial gravity milti hai: ghoomte jahaz ki satah us se lagi cheez ko dhakelti hai aur yun woh centripetal force deti hai jo cheez ko dairawi raste par rakhti hai (Do You Know).

blocks.alt: Chaar teeliyon (spokes) aur markaz wala pahiya-numa space station, naranji teer ke mutabiq ghoomta hua. Bahari kinare ke andar astronaut khara hai, aur surkh teer dikhata hai ke farsh astronaut ko markaz ki taraf dhakelta hai. Note samjhata hai ke yeh centripetal dhakka wazan jaisa lagta hai, aur farsh bahari kinare par hota hai.
blocks.caption: Masnooi gravity ke liye ghoomta pahiya-numa spaceship (Figure 3.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Satellite 200 km ki oonchai par ghoomta hai; Zameen ka radius 6400 km le kar us ki madari speed nikalein. 20 m radius ka space station 0.5 rad s^-1 se ghoomta hai; astronauts kaun si artificial gravity mehsoos karte hain (numerical problems 3.7, 3.8)? Astronaut be-wazni kaise mehsoos karta hai (short question 3.9)?
blocks.explanation: r = 6600 km = 6.6 x 10^6 m, to v = sqrt(GM/r) = sqrt(6.67 x 10^-11 x 6.0 x 10^24 / 6.6 x 10^6) = 7.78 x 10^3 m s^-1 = 7.78 km s^-1 (chhapa jawab unit km h^-1 deta hai). Artificial gravity a_c = R omega^2 = 20 x 0.25 = 5 m s^-2. Astronaut aur satellite dono ek hi acceleration v^2/r = g se Zameen ki taraf azadana girte hain, to sahare ki force F_N ki zaroorat nahi aur mehsoos bhi nahi hoti: zahiri be-wazni.

items: Neecha madar: g = v^2/R, v = sqrt(gR) = 7.9 km s^-1 (critical velocity), T = 84 min; oonche madaron ko kam speed chahiye aur zyada waqt lagta hai (g 1/r^2 se ghatta hai). Madari velocity v = sqrt(GM/r), satellite ke mass se azaad (Example 3.4: 384 000 km par 27.7 din).
Be-wazni: mg - F_N = m v^2/r aur g = v^2/r se F_N = 0; satellite azadana girta jism hai. Artificial gravity: jahaz yun ghumayein ke R omega^2 = g, f = (1/2 pi) sqrt(g/R).
